notesForTheReviewer: A finding outside this issue, with its evidence, sent to the architect rather than filed: internal/cmdtest's new TestFreeTCPPortsLieOutsideTheKernelsOwnPortRange fails in a Legion worker pod, and it is right to. This pod's /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range reads '16000 65535', while cmdtest's freePortHigh is 32767, so the helper's range lies inside the kernel's own ephemeral range here and FreeTCPPort can hand out a port the kernel may also give to an outgoing connection - the flake the test exists to prevent. On a GitHub runner the default range starts at 32768, so the guard passes there and the overlap never appears. The consequence is not this test: it is that every test using cmdtest.FreeTCPPort in a Legion pod has that collision open. Nothing of this branch touches cmdtest; recorded here and reported so it can be routed.
